articles.title: 2026 Douglas County Fair To Reveal Nightly Entertainment Lineup Tuesday

articles.description: Winston-Dillard School District will provide free Spring Break meals for children 18 and younger next week, with grab-and-go stops at schools and parks in Winston and Dillard. Meals are sponsored by Cow Creek and the district.
articles.title: Winston-Dillard School District To Offer Free Spring Break Meals

articles.author: Joseph Ziegler
articles.description: Roseburg hit 80 degrees Monday, making it the hottest day of 2026 so far and setting a new record high for March 16 at the Roseburg Regional Airport. The previous record for the date was 78 degrees, set in 1959.
articles.title: Roseburg Hits 80 Degrees, Sets New Hottest Day of 2026 So Far

articles.description: The 47th Annual Roseburg Benefit Car Show brought about 70 classic and custom vehicles to the Douglas County Fairgrounds this weekend, raising money for Douglas County Search and Rescue and the Special Materials Fund for local children with special needs.
articles.title: Roseburg Benefit Car Show Draws Crowd for 47th Annual Weekend Supporting Local Causes

articles.description: Roseburg police log entries from March 13-16 included multiple DUII arrests, warrant arrests, trespass and prohibited camping cases, a no-contact-order violation, a disorderly conduct arrest, and other enforcement actions across the city.
articles.title: Police Log: March 13 - March 16, 2026

articles.description: The Winston VFW will host its expanded 2nd Annual 4th of July Car Show and Vendor Event on July 4 in Winston, featuring vehicles, motorcycles, shopping, music and a 50/50 raffle. Admission is free, with organizers hoping to double last year’s turnout.
articles.title: Winston VFW To Host 2nd Annual 4th Of July Car Show And Vendor Event

articles.description: The Canyonville Community Library will host a meet-and-greet with Oregon 2nd Congressional District candidate Dawn Rasmussen on Wednesday, March 18. The event gives community members a chance to hear from Rasmussen, ask questions and discuss issues affecting the district.
articles.title: Canyonville Library To Host Meet-And-Greet With Congressional Candidate Dawn Rasmussen

articles.author: Joseph Ziegler
articles.description: The Canyonville Community Library is holding a spring raffle fundraiser featuring 25 prize packages donated by local businesses and community members. Proceeds will support library programs, services and resources, with the drawing set for April 11 during the library’s spring book sale.
articles.title: Canyonville Community Library Launches Spring Raffle To Support Programs And Services
